about: The shell host protocol's messages (plan-modular-packages r4 addendum A1.4): each name the shell module may pass to hostCall, with the SHELL_HOST_LEVEL that introduced it. Append-only: a new message, or a compatible widening of one (a new optional field), adds a row at the next level; removing or narrowing one needs a new major and is refused in review unless planned. "fields" lists the widenings: "name.field.path" with the level that added the field, the message keeping the level that introduced it; a module that sends a widened message must send it as an object literal, so the fields it sends are read from its code. SHELL_HOST_LEVEL (web/shell/loader.ts) is the highest level here, names and fields; scripts/optional-packages.mjs computes each js package's host_req from it.
